# Lucy & Nell Harcourt

- [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — welcomed her home warmly with Robin · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.
>
> — v2 · VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)_

> During an [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) tricks [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) into jumping into a pigpen and getting drenched under the water pump. After [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is sent to his room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talks with him, prompting [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to confess that he also hid a toad under Thirza's pillow, which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) secretly removes.
>
> — v2 · VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P50](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0050), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home through the woods, chatting with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) along the way. Upon arriving at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she learns from [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). When confronted about his trickery and lying, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) away.
>
> — v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss Robin's habit of lying and punish him by sending him to bed without dinner. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) in his room, where he tries to argue that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) lied about the consequences of skipping prayers. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and after going downstairs, she and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discuss Robin's mischievous behavior and how best to raise him.
>
> — v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P63](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0063), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085)_

> Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about church bazaar plans before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes home to discuss family letters with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and handle Robin's comedic mischief. Later, at a B.V.I.S. meeting, [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) reveals that [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) plans to rent his farm fence for commercial ads, sparking panic among the members.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P12](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0012), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

> In the [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) kitchen, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) shares his funny childhood misunderstanding about heaven before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reveals exciting news from a letter: the famous author Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) are coming to visit. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enthusiastically plans and prepares a elaborate dinner menu for the upcoming visit, while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) assist with the preparations.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020)_

> During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P60](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0060), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed after helping him settle his worries about her feelings compared to [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). Later, she meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) near the Nymph's Well, where they talk about community improvements and mutual friends before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to plan her tasks with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P61](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0061)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) depart for town, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) at home. While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> During breakfast at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's appearance and past engagement, while dealing with Robin's table manners. A month later, a letter arrives revealing that [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md) has passed away, leaving a trust fund for the twins so they can remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dismisses school early as a monstrous storm approaches, exactly as [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) predicted. She rushes home with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where they shelter with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) through a terrifying 45-minute hail storm that devastates crops and shatters windows. Afterward, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) arrives to report that lightning struck Mr. Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer comfort.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) after the storm kills his parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md). The community assesses the widespread destruction, while [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) revels in the exactness of his storm prediction. Hugh visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to recount the panic at the school and discuss the damage with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P48](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0048), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde reflect on past times and their upcoming departures while resting after gathering apples. Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets Hugh at the bridge, where his affectionate gesture makes her uncomfortable and prompts her to head home. At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts young [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), who questions her about leaving for college.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) departs from [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after emotional goodbyes, traveling by train and ferry alongside Hugh and Wilfred. Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), she is greeted by [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), who escorts her to their new boardinghouse while chatting to brighten Nell's spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday, where she is warmly welcomed by Isolde, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Sowerby, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md). Before bed, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) confesses his desire to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gently helps him overcome his conflict. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives letters from [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Cressida, sharing their news and humorous stories.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 ch.Again P47](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0047)_

> Rebellious over Mrs. Sowerby's strict rules, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) throws away his collection money, forces [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to skip Sunday School, and goes fishing with the Cotton children instead. After returning home and telling a series of lies to Mrs. Sowerby to cover up his absence, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is overcome with guilt and tearfully confesses his misdeeds to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) late that night.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P21](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0021), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P58](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0058), [v3 ch.Transgressors P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns weary to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is woken up by a distressed [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) tearfully confesses his misdeeds of the day, including skipping Sunday School, lying, and cursing, fearing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) will dislike him. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts him, explains the concept of conscience, and encourages him to ask for God's forgiveness, which [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) does before finally leaving her to sleep.
>

> In the orchard at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Agatha, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chat about a local funeral, schoolwork, and Isolde's upcoming wedding. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on Hugh Carrow's proposal turning into local gossip, feels anxious about the upcoming changes, and misses Hugh's presence while receiving regular letters from [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md).
>
